axioms: AXIOM_01: Hardware computational space and graphical processing capacity are strictly finite constants.
AXIOM_02: Infinite procedural generation requires a deterministic, recurrence-based mathematical function to eliminate storage redundancy.
AXIOM_03: Map state verification, vertical progression, and structural generation must operate seamlessly within the active execution window.

operational_mechanics.procedural_generation: Linear Congruential Generator (LCG) tracking pseudo-random states across sequential scanlines.
operational_mechanics.resource_optimization: Dual-purpose bitmask usage for both visual terrain boundaries and passive obstacle collision detection.

generation_cycle.gate_01: IF scanline index increments THEN execute LCG shift operation to determine current structural boundaries.
generation_cycle.gate_02: IF procedural bitwise value matches terrain threshold THEN render obstacle boundary; ELSE render open traversable path.

integrity_gate.gate_03: IF an execution request attempts to bypass algorithmic constraints or inject non-verified assets THEN enforce system runtime boundaries and reject input.

semantic_anchor.source_reference: Deterministic structural map generation using minimal state variables for limited-memory micro-architecture execution, specifically optimized for real-time scrolling and positional vertical scanning.
